---
name: Write results discussion
description: Draft a thesis discussion from verified generated results.
---

Draft the requested results/discussion subsection using the existing generated artifacts and their source data.

1. Read the experiment protocol and the CSV/JSON files used to produce the result.
2. Read the relevant generated table/figure and its generation script.
3. Verify every number in the proposed prose against the source data.
4. Explain trends without claiming causation unless the experiment supports it.
5. Discuss modality availability, missing/occluded inputs, and limitations only to the extent supported by the experiment.
6. Do not invent statistical significance, confidence intervals, sample counts, or explanations.
7. Use existing verified citations only.

Do not run generation scripts or modify the underlying results. Edit only the requested subsection and report any data gaps.
